symptom: Krita MCP ellipse fill looks stamped; Qwen InstantX inpaint upscaled 960->1536 and turned brown iris grey-green; Qwen edit fixed the pupil but restyled the whole face/hair
root_cause: krita-cli has no AI Diffusion generate/inpaint hook (UI docker only). Qwen InstantX pack default max-dim 1536. Qwen edit is global instruction so it beautifies unmasked areas. Anima inpaint denoise 0.8 oversaturated to glowing orange.
fix: Same Comfy 8188 via generate_anima --mode inpaint at native WxH, mask only the iris, denoise 0.65-0.7, chestnut brown iris tags. Do not use krita_draw_shape for eyes.
prevention: For anime local retouch: Anima inpaint + tight mask + mid denoise. Never drive Krita AI Diffusion from MCP. Pin --max-dim to source size on Qwen inpaint. Do not ellipse-paint irises.
